resources.string: Control your Android TV from your phone.
Works only on your local Wi-Fi. No account, no cloud, nothing leaves your home network.
Android needs your permission before the app can find and talk to TVs on your Wi-Fi. It is used only for that.
Without local network access the app can\'t reach your TV. You can allow it now or later.
Local network access is turned off for this app. Turn it on in Settings so the app can reach your TV.
TV is on a different network
Your phone\'s Wi-Fi doesn\'t include the TV\'s last known address. Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi as the TV (not a guest network).
